Alex: meet Iggy, our rescue green iguana. finally got a sunlamp selfie that doesn’t look like a blurry lizard ghost :sunglasses: pic: https://imgur.com/IGGYsun2
Sam: wow those scales are like neon confetti :heart_eyes:
Cleo: absolute diva energy. vote: tiny sunglasses or tiny bandana? :sparkles:
Alex: team poll: sunglasses = Thrift Store Glam, bandana = Picnic Vibes. I’ll post a slow-mo of the tongue-flick later.
Nina: also, is he kid-friendly? my niece wants to visit.
Alex: very gentle with handling, slow mover. happy for a calm meet-and-greet. will DM a short care checklist.
Cleo: if anyone has craft supplies i’ll make iguana couture. felt, googly eyes (for the sunglasses), optional sequins. :sewing_machine:
Sam: "iguana couture" is officially a thing now. signing up to be model wrangler. :joy:
OpsBot: Reminder: Pet Photo Friday at 3pm in #random — bring your critters! :paw_prints:
Alex: lamp schedule question from Nina: we do 2x20min morning + 1x30min afternoon, basking ~95°F, ambient ~78°F. ceramic heater for backups.
Nina: perfect, thanks. pls include tips for gentle introductions for kids.
Cleo: tiny sunglasses prototype arriving this week. will report back with runway shots. :camera_with_flash:
Sam: can someone add Iggy to the pet roster? i’ll create a tiny slack emoji if approved. :grin:
Alex: yes please add. emoji name suggestion: :iggy_sun:
